checks.name: help
checks.stdout:
Bounded NV12/P010 ASCII video pipeline

Usage: asciiflow [OPTIONS] <INPUT> [OUTPUT]

Arguments:
  <INPUT>   Local input media file; qualified MP4 input combinations only
  [OUTPUT]  MP4 output path; omitted only for capability or plan inspection

Options:
      --backend <BACKEND>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, cpu, vulkan]
      --vulkan-mapping <VULKAN_MAPPING>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, gpu, cpu]
      --decode <DECODE>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, software, vaapi]
      --encode <ENCODE>
          Video encoder; software H.264 8-bit SDR depends on libx264 and is excluded from the official LGPL prebuilt release [default: auto] [possible values: auto, software, vaapi]
      --output-codec <OUTPUT_CODEC>
          Output codec: H.264 is 8-bit only; HEVC/AV1 require qualified VAAPI encoding [default: h264] [possible values: h264, hevc, av1]
      --output-bit-depth <OUTPUT_BIT_DEPTH>
          Output depth: 10 requires HEVC/AV1; no SDR bit-depth conversion is implemented [default: 8] [possible values: 8, 10]
      --output-dynamic-range <OUTPUT_DYNAMIC_RANGE>
          preserve keeps SDR or canonical limited BT.2020 NCL/PQ (PQ needs 10-bit HEVC/AV1); sdr explicitly converts canonical PQ <=1000 cd/m2 to BT.709 SDR and is a no-op for SDR. PQ requires the qualified VAAPI/Vulkan interop path; HLG and full range are unsupported [default: preserve] [possible values: preserve, sdr]
      --audio <AUDIO>
          Compressed audio passthrough, not transcoding: auto omits incompatible tracks, copy rejects them, none omits audio. Copy requires the existing CFR timeline [default: auto] [possible values: auto, copy, none]
      --hw-device <HW_DEVICE>
          
      --vaapi-vulkan-input-interop <VAAPI_VULKAN_INPUT_INTEROP>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, off, on]
      --vaapi-vulkan-output-interop <VAAPI_VULKAN_OUTPUT_INTEROP>
          [default: auto] [possible values: auto, off, on]
      --explain-plan
          Inspect the selected plan without creating video output
      --capabilities
          Inspect detected capabilities without creating video output
      --diagnostic-report <PATH>
          Write structured diagnostics as JSON; refuses to overwrite an existing file
      --width <WIDTH>
          [default: 160]
      --height <HEIGHT>
          
      --charset <CHARSET>
          [default: standard]
      --font <FONT>
          builtin-8x8 or an explicit scalable monospaced FreeType font file [default: builtin-8x8]
      --font-face-index <FONT_FACE_INDEX>
          [default: 0]
      --color <COLOR>
          [default: true] [possible values: true, false]
      --max-frames <MAX_FRAMES>
          Limit video frames (0 means unlimited); selected audio is still fully drained [default: 0]
      --no-progress
          
  -v, --verbose
          Show detailed device and aggregate performance diagnostics
  -h, --help
          Print help
  -V, --version
          Print version
